## Description

The downsampling processor (`downsamplingprocessor`) reduces the volume of telemetry data by downsampling it.

## Configuration

The `downsamplingprocessor` can be configured with the following options:

| Key                | Type   | Default | Description                                                               |
| -------------------| ------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `interval`         | string | `15s`   | The time interval at which the processor emits aggregated telemetry data. |
| `cardinality_limit`| uint32 | `8192`  | The maximum number of unique metric streams the processor will track.     |

## Examples

```yaml
processors:
  downsampling:
    # Emits aggregated metrics every 10 seconds
    interval: 10s
    # Limits the number of unique metric streams to 5000
    cardinality_limit: 5000
```

## Warnings

- [Statefulness](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/blob/v0.122.0/docs/standard-warnings.md#statefulness): The `downsamplingprocessor` calculates aggregated data points by keeping track of the metric stream. This means that the aggregated data points are only accurate if the metrics are continuously sent to the same instance of the collector.
